enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Screaming: Screaming weapons emit a piercing screech whenever they are used to make a successful attack. This screech does an additional 1 to 6 sonic damage.
Roaring: This weapon causes targets to become shaken (DC 25 Will save negates) and, on a critical hit, does 2 to 12 sonic damage to the target.
